join hortbot 999 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!testing_error hello
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!command add pan FOUND THE (_PARAMETER_CAPS_), HAVE YE?
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Command 'pan' added, restricted to subscribers and above.

# Good message, for reference:
# handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!pan working command

handle hortbot foobar/- - :!pan working command
no_send

handle hortbot #/1 foobar/1 :!pan working command
send hortbot #foobar [HB] FOUND THE WORKING COMMAND, HAVE YE?

handle hortbot - foobar/1 :!pan working command
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/- foobar/- :!pan working command
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 message-id=- :!pan working command
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/0 foobar/1 :!pan working command
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/- foobar/1 :!pan working command
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/0 :!pan working command
no_send

handle snortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!pan working command
no_send

handle hortbot barfoo/2 foobar/1 :!pan working command
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :    
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/- :!pan working command
no_send
